prose: Kerri Hummingbird is the author of several books, and host of the Soul Nectar podcast. We discuss Kerri's 2019 book, The Second Wave: Transcending The Human Drama, a book about getting past the amnesiac state of life on Earth. We also talk about White Eagle, a Native ancestor who connects with Kerri in the astral to give guidance.
ext: We cover working with crystals, the native Peruvian way; walking barefoot on blazing coals; Earth's gut biome of negative emotion eating etheric entities.
